<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10:8">Num. R. s. 10</cite> (ref. to the precautions prescribed for the Nazarite, <cite ref="Numbers 6:3">Num. VI, 3</cite>) <he>מתלא אמר לך לך אמרין</he> (<cite ref="L00000"><he>ל</he></cite>)<he>נ׳ סחור וכ׳</he> the proverb says, go, go, they say (to the) Nazarite, go all around that thou mayest not come near the vineyard; <cite ref="Shabbat 13a:10">Sabb. 13ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>משום לך לך אמרי נ׳ וכ׳</he> as a measure of precaution; a. e.—Pl. <cite ref="N00445"><he>נְזִירִין</he></cite>, <he>נְזִירַיָּא</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 5:4:1">Y. Naz. V, end, 54ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 91:3">Gen. R. s. 91</cite>; a. fr.
